description: Fix light mode text visibility across all DM components. The current light mode overrides in dm.scss only change hover backgrounds and bubble colors but do NOT fix text colors for most elements. In light mode, CSS variables like --primary-text-color resolve to dark colors, but many hardcoded fallbacks (#fff) and hardcoded backgrounds (#2f3336) remain problematic. Need comprehensive light mode fixes for: search input, chat room item text, header text/icons, compose area, modal text, timestamps, secondary text, sender names, skeleton loading colors.
steps: Read app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss fully to understand the current light mode section

Expand the html[data-color-scheme='light'] block in dm.scss to fix ALL text visibility issues. Specifically add overrides for: .dm-chat-room-list-header__title (ensure dark color), .dm-chat-room-list-header__search-input (dark text on light bg, lighter background), .dm-chat-room-item__name (dark text), .dm-chat-room-item__preview (readable secondary), .dm-chat-room-item__time (readable secondary), .dm-chat-room-header__name (dark text), .dm-chat-room-header__members (readable secondary), .dm-chat-room-header__back-btn (dark icon), .dm-chat-room-header__settings-btn (readable), .dm-message-item__sender-name (readable), .dm-message-item__time (readable), .dm-message-item__read-status (readable), .dm-message-compose__input (dark text on light bg), .dm-message-compose__btn (dark icons), .dm-message-compose__send (dark icon when inactive), .dm-new-chat-modal__content (light background), .dm-new-chat-modal__title (dark text), .dm-new-chat-modal__input-label (readable), .dm-new-chat-modal__search-input (dark text), .dm-new-chat-modal__result-name (dark text), .dm-new-chat-modal__result-handle (readable secondary), .dm-new-chat-modal__group-input (dark text on light bg), .dm-date-separator__text (readable), .dm-chat-room-view__loading (readable), .dm-migration-banner__text (readable), .dm-skeleton-avatar/.dm-skeleton-line/.dm-skeleton-bubble/.dm-skeleton-message-avatar (lighter gray for light mode), .dm-chat-room-item__avatar-placeholder/.dm-chat-room-header__avatar-placeholder/.dm-message-item__avatar-placeholder (lighter gray)
Ensure the .dm-message-bubble--other has proper background (#eff3f4 or similar light gray) and dark text color (#0f1419) in light mode - this is already done but verify
Make sure hover states use rgba(0,0,0,X%) instead of rgba(255,255,255,X%) in light mode for all interactive elements
Ensure the new chat modal in light mode has proper background, text colors, and border visibility
acceptance_criteria: Every text element in the DM interface has a clearly readable dark color when html[data-color-scheme='light'] is active
Background elements (avatar placeholders, skeleton loaders, input fields) use appropriately light gray colors in light mode
Hover states use dark-tinted backgrounds (rgba(0,0,0,...)) in light mode instead of white-tinted
The light mode section is comprehensive - no DM element is missed
No changes break dark mode appearance
verification: Run: ruby -c app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss || echo 'N/A for SCSS' && echo 'SCSS file updated - verify visually'
Verify the file has comprehensive light mode overrides by checking that all major class names are covered in the html[data-color-scheme='light'] block
findings: SCSS compiles cleanly with npx sass. Expanded light mode block from 12 lines to 194 lines covering all DM components. Used #0f1419 for primary text, #536471 for secondary text, #e1e8ed for placeholder/skeleton backgrounds, #f7f9f9 for search input background, #fff for modal background. All hover states use rgba(0,0,0,X%) pattern.
